-   **Rarity note:** Common throughout Florida, found in agricultural fields or near cattle.

## Natural history notes

A medium-sized white heron characterized by its compact body, short thick neck, yellow bill, and buff-orange plumes on the head, chest, and back during breeding season. In Florida, it is found in pastures, agricultural fields, lawns, roadsides, wetlands, marsh edges, and other open areas, often near cattle or other large animals. It feeds mainly on grasshoppers, crickets, flies, frogs, lizards, and other small animals, often walking through fields or following livestock and machinery that flush prey.
